implementation.callLowering: Managed direct calls receive deterministic ABI argument copies, fixed x10 return definitions, x1 link definition, explicit caller-saved clobbers and stable target identity before allocation.
implementation.returnLowering: Managed JALR returns apply the proven 252-byte compensation for the ISE PC+4 link semantics and 256-byte bundle stride.
implementation.allocation: ABI call/return values are precolored and cannot spill; non-leaf x1 preservation, callee saves and ordinary spills are selected by the existing schedule-aware allocator.
implementation.frame: The authoritative native ABI frame request is finalized after allocation and contains only required spill, callee-save and non-leaf return-address slots.
implementation.finalScheduling: Synthetic and physical instructions carry deterministic ranks derived from the selected pre-RA schedule; physical RAW/WAR/WAW, memory, control and serialization dependencies are rebuilt before final scheduling and bundling.
implementation.iseGap: The existing instruction transport already carried BaseReg, but scalar Load/Store execution used only the immediate Address. The minimal ISE correction resolves signed displacement from the transported base register before translation and memory access.
